_comment: Decisions taken on docs/judgement-calls.xlsx. wiki_xref.py reads this so a settled row is not asked again; wiki_decisions.py carries 'Needs more thought' forward into the next sheet. Keyed by file+category+name+used_by. NOTE: a row with only a Notes value and a blank Decision is still an answer - eleven were missed that way once, so read both columns.
